description_en: Modifies the attributes of an image, including the name and description of the image
description_zh: 修改镜像的属性，包括镜像的名称和描述
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-image-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-2g65ljy3ynrdq0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyImageAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. The name must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的描述信息。长度为2\~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description
